# Delivery rules

- **R-1** When work is managed, the lead MUST keep task status in `tasks/<id>.json` with `krn task`; workers MUST NOT edit tracker files.
- **R-2** When agent state is written, the author MUST keep it under `.krn/`, which is ignored by git.
- **R-3** When a change is ready, the author MUST obtain a green `ci / Check` on the exact HEAD; the repository has no other required gate.
- **R-4** When a commit completes a managed task, its last trailer paragraph MUST carry `Ticket: <id>` (`Refs: <id>` while the task stays open).
<!-- krn-adoption:end -->

# Standards

- **s-tests-tracked** The repository tracks automated tests next to the code they cover. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(tests?|__tests__|spec)/|(_test\.go|_test\.py|(^|/)test_[^/]*\.py|\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?)$' || git grep -qIE '#\[(cfg\(test\)|([a-z_]+::)*test(\(.*\))?)\]' -- '*.rs'`)_
- **s-test-command** The repository declares one test command that runs its tests, never a placeholder. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `if [ -s package.json ]; then node -e 'const t=(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{}).test||"";process.exit(t.trim()===""||/no test specified/.test(t)?1:0)'; elif [ -f composer.json ] || [ -f phpunit.xml ] || [ -f phpunit.xml.dist ]; then if [ -f phpunit.xml ] || [ -f phpunit.xml.dist ]; then true; else node -e 'const s=(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8")).scripts||{}).test;process.exit(s===undefined||/no test specified/.test(JSON.stringify(s))?1:0)'; fi; elif [ -f go.mod ]; then git ls-files | grep -q '_test\.go$'; elif [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)tests/[^/]+\.rs$' || git grep -qIE '#\[(cfg\(test\)|([a-z_]+::)*test(\(.*\))?)\]' -- '*.rs'; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f setup.cfg ] || [ -f setup.py ] || [ -f tox.ini ] || [ -f pytest.ini ]; then git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(test_[^/]*|[^/]*_test)\.py$'; else grep -qE '^test:' Makefile 2>/dev/null; fi`)_
- **s-test-exit-code** The test command exits non-zero when a test fails: no `|| true`, `; exit 0` or leading `-` masks its status. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `{ [ ! -s package.json ] || node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{};const bad=Object.entries(s).filter(([k,v])=>/^test/.test(k)&&/\|\|\s*(true|:|exit 0)|;\s*exit 0\s*$/.test(String(v)));if(bad.length){console.error("masked: "+bad.map(b=>b[0]).join(", "));process.exit(1)}'; } && { [ ! -f Makefile ] || awk '/^test[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*:/{t=1;next} /^[^\t]/{t=0} t&&(/\|\| *(true|:)/||/^\t-/){bad=1} END{exit bad}' Makefile; }`)_
- **s-ci-runs-tests** Continuous integration runs the tests on every pull request. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `ci=$(cat .github/workflows/*.yml .github/workflows/*.yaml .gitlab-ci.yml 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE 'pull_request|merge_request' && printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE '(pytest|tox|nox|unittest|(npm|pnpm|yarn|bun)( run)? test|vitest|jest|node --test|go test|cargo test|make test|uv run|hatch run|poetry run|phpunit|composer( run)? test)|uses: *[^ ]*/[^ ]*ci\.ya?ml'`)_
- **s-lockfile-committed** The dependency lockfile of the stack is tracked, so every checkout installs the same versions. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(package-lock\.json|npm-shrinkwrap\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|bun\.lockb?|uv\.lock|poetry\.lock|Pipfile\.lock|pdm\.lock|requirements[^/]*\.txt|go\.sum|go\.mod|Cargo\.lock)$'`)_
- **s-no-secrets-tracked** No tracked file is a credential file or holds a private key or provider token. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -vE '\.env\.(example|sample|template|dist)$' | grep -qE '(^|/)(\.env(\.[^/]*)?|id_rsa|id_ecdsa|id_ed25519|[^/]*\.pem|[^/]*\.p12|\.netrc|\.git-credentials)$' && ! git grep -qIE -e '-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----' -e 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}' -e 'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' -e 'xox[abp]-[0-9A-Za-z-]{20,}'`)_
- **s-no-dependency-dirs-tracked** Installed dependencies, caches and bytecode are never tracked. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(node_modules|__pycache__|\.venv|venv|\.pytest_cache|\.mypy_cache|\.ruff_cache|\.tox)/|\.py[co]$'`)_
- **s-linter-configured** A formatter or linter is configured for the stack, so style is checked by a tool, not by review. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `for f in biome.json biome.jsonc .eslintrc .eslintrc.* eslint.config.* .prettierrc .prettierrc.* prettier.config.* ruff.toml .ruff.toml .flake8 .pylintrc .golangci.yml .golangci.yaml .golangci.toml rustfmt.toml .rustfmt.toml phpcs.xml phpcs.xml.dist .phpcs.xml phpstan.neon phpstan.neon.dist .php-cs-fixer.php .php-cs-fixer.dist.php pint.json psalm.xml; do [ -e "$f" ] && exit 0; done; grep -qE '^\[tool\.(ruff|black|flake8|pylint)' pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null || grep -qE '"(@biomejs/biome|eslint|prettier)"' package.json 2>/dev/null || cat .github/workflows/*.y*ml 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'gofmt|go vet|golangci|cargo fmt|cargo clippy'`)_
- **s-readme-test-command** The README states how to run the tests. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `cat README* readme* 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '(pytest|tox|nox|unittest|(npm|pnpm|yarn|bun)( run)? test|vitest|jest|node --test|go test|cargo test|make test|uv run|hatch run|poetry run|phpunit|composer( run)? test)'`)_
- **s-no-conflict-markers** No tracked file holds an unresolved merge conflict marker. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>) '`)_
- **s-one-instruction-file** A repository keeps one instruction file for agents, AGENTS.md; any other agent instruction file is a link to it or points to it. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `for f in CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md .cursorrules .github/copilot-instructions.md; do [ ! -e "$f" ] || [ "$(readlink "$f")" = AGENTS.md ] || grep -q 'AGENTS.md' "$f" || { echo "$f does not point to AGENTS.md" >&2; exit 1; }; done`)_
- **s-clean-checkout-tests** The test suite gives the same verdict on a clean checkout: no test depends on untracked local state such as an earlier build or the enclosing repository. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -s package.json ] || node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{};if(/\b(build|tsc|tsup|esbuild|rollup|webpack)\b/.test([s.pretest,s.test].join(" ")))process.exit(0);const files=cp.execFileSync("git",["ls-files","-z"],{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0");if(files.some(f=>/(^|\/)dist\//.test(f)))process.exit(0);const bad=files.filter(f=>/\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$|(^|\/)(tests?|__tests__)\/.*\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.test(f)&&fs.existsSync(f)&&/["\x27`][^"\x27`\s]*\bdist\/[^"\x27`\s]*\.[cm]?js["\x27`]/.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")));if(bad.length){console.error("tests read untracked dist/ output but the test script builds nothing: "+bad.slice(0,3).join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-regression-lowest-layer** A fixed defect gets its regression test in the same commit: each of the last ten `fix` commits touches a test file, or carries a `No-test: <reason>` line. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || git log --no-merges -n 10 --format=%H | while read -r c; do git log -1 --format=%s "$c" | grep -qE '^fix(\([^)]*\))?!?: ' || continue; git log -1 --format=%B "$c" | grep -qE '^No-test: .+' && continue; git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r --root "$c" | grep -qE '(^|/)(tests?|__tests__|spec)/|_test\.(go|py)$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\.py$|\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$|Test\.php$' || exit 1; done`)_
- **s-role-names** Files, functions, tests and work are named by purpose and role, never by phase, ticket, round, date or version. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -vE '(^|/)fixtures/' | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs|py|php|sh|go)$' | grep -qiE '(^|[-_./])((phase|slice|round|ticket|sprint)[-_.]?[0-9]+|t-[a-z0-9]{7})([-_.]|$)|20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|[-_.]v[0-9]+[-_.]'`)_
- **s-exit-codes** Every error path has a stated exit code (64 usage, 65 invalid data, 70 internal, 75 temporary) and a message on stderr. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '(catch[^{]*\{[^}]*process\.exit\([[:space:]]*0|except[^:]*:[[:space:]]*(sys\.)?exit\([[:space:]]*0)' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.py'`)_
- **s-secrets-redacted** Values that may hold credentials, multiline ones included, are redacted before they are logged, persisted or forwarded. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIiE '(console\.(log|error|warn|info|debug)|logger\.[a-z]+|logging\.[a-z]+|print|echo)[[:space:]]*\(?.*(password|passwd|secret|api_?key|private_?key|auth_?token|access_?token)[A-Za-z_]*[[:space:]]*[,)+}]' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.py' '*.php' '*.sh' ':(exclude)test' ':(exclude)tests' ':(exclude)__tests__' ':(exclude)*.test.*' ':(exclude)*.spec.*' ':(exclude)*/fixtures/*'`)_
- **s-no-shared-stash** Never change the git stash stack with a bare `git stash` or `git stash pop`; set work aside with a commit. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE 'git[[:space:]]+stash([[:space:]]+(push|save|pop|apply|drop|clear)([^A-Za-z]|$)|[[:space:]]*($|[;&|)"]))' -- '*.sh' '*.bash' '*.yml' '*.yaml' Makefile justfile package.json`)_
- **s-semantic-commits** Commit subjects since the repository adopted krn are semantic: `type(scope): outcome` with a conventional type such as feat, fix, docs, chore or refactor. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! { a=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- krn.json 2>/dev/null | tail -1); git log --no-merges -n 20 --format=%s ${a:+$a..HEAD}; } | grep -vE '^(Revert "|(feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|test|perf|build|ci|style|revert)(\([^)]+\))?!?: )' | grep -q .`)_
- **s-noninteractive-remote-commands** Tracked shell scripts run ssh and scp with `-o BatchMode=yes` and apt-get install with `-y`, so they fail instead of waiting for a prompt. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -hIE '^[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(ssh|scp)[[:space:]]|apt-get[[:space:]]+install' -- '*.sh' | grep -vE 'BatchMode=yes|apt-get[[:space:]]+install[^#]*[[:space:]]-y' | grep -q .`)_
- **s-no-whitespace-errors** Uncommitted changes pass `git diff --check`: no trailing whitespace, no space-before-tab, no conflict markers. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || git diff --check HEAD`)_
- **s-no-private-key-tracked** No tracked file holds a PEM private key block (a line that starts with `-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----`), outside test fixtures. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '^-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----' -- . ':(exclude)test' ':(exclude)tests' ':(exclude)*/fixtures/*'`)_
- **s-go-gofmt** Tracked Go files are gofmt-formatted, so formatting is never a review topic. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `printf 'package p\n' | gofmt -l >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(git ls-files '*.go' | grep -vE '(^|/)(vendor|testdata)/' | while IFS= read -r f; do gofmt -l "$f" 2>&1; done); [ -z "$out" ]`)_
- **s-go-vet-run** Go vet or a golangci-lint configuration runs in the repository's checks (a golangci config, workflow, Makefile or script names it). _(checked by `krn standards check`: `git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)\.golangci\.(yml|yaml|toml|json)$' || git grep -qIE 'go vet|golangci|staticcheck' -- .github Makefile makefile GNUmakefile 'Taskfile*' magefile.go .gitlab-ci.yml scripts script hack .pre-commit-config.yaml 2>/dev/null`)_
- **s-go-sum-committed** A Go module that requires other modules tracks go.sum beside its go.mod. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `for m in $(git ls-files 'go.mod' '*/go.mod' | grep -vE '(^|/)(vendor|testdata)/'); do grep -qE '^(require[[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.[A-Za-z]+/[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+v[0-9]' "$m" || continue; d=$(dirname "$m"); s="$d/go.sum"; [ "$d" = . ] && s=go.sum; git ls-files | grep -qxF "$s" || { echo "$m has no tracked go.sum" >&2; exit 1; }; done; exit 0`)_
- **s-go-wrapped-errors** Go errors that are passed on are wrapped with `%w`, not formatted with `%v` or `%s`. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE 'fmt\.Errorf\("[^"]*%[vs]",[[:space:]]*([^"]*,[[:space:]]*)?err\)' -- '*.go' ':(exclude)*_test.go' ':(exclude)vendor' ':(exclude)*/vendor/*' ':(exclude)testdata' ':(exclude)*/testdata/*'`)_
- **s-go-no-library-panic** Go library code returns errors instead of calling `panic`: only package main, init, Must* constructors, tests and generated code may panic. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `bad=$(git ls-files '*.go' | grep -vE '(_test\.go$|(^|/)(vendor|testdata|cmd|tools|examples?)/)' | while IFS= read -r f; do grep -qE '^package main$' "$f" && continue; grep -q 'Code generated' "$f" && continue; awk '/^func /{fn=$0} /^[[:space:]]*\/\//{next} /panic\(/ && fn !~ /^func (\([^)]*\) )?(Must|init\()/ {bad=1} END{exit bad}' "$f" || echo "$f"; done); [ -z "$bad" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$bad" >&2; exit 1; }`)_
- **s-go-tests-beside-code** Every Go package directory that declares functions has a _test.go file beside its code (package main, generated code and cmd, tools and examples directories excepted). _(checked by `krn standards check`: `all=$(git ls-files '*.go' | grep -vE '(^|/)(vendor|testdata|cmd|tools|examples?|mocks?|gen|generated|pb|proto)/'); tested=$(printf '%s\n' "$all" | grep '_test\.go$' | while IFS= read -r f; do dirname "$f"; done | sort -u); bad=$(printf '%s\n' "$all" | grep -v '_test\.go$' | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] || continue; grep -qE '^package main$' "$f" && continue; grep -q 'Code generated' "$f" && continue; grep -q '^func ' "$f" || continue; dirname "$f"; done | sort -u | while IFS= read -r d; do printf '%s\n' "$tested" | grep -qxF "$d" || echo "$d"; done); [ -z "$bad" ] || { printf 'no test beside: %s\n' "$bad" >&2; exit 1; }`)_
- **s-go-context-first** A Go function that takes a context.Context takes it as its first parameter. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '^func[^{]*\(([^()]*,)[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*[[:space:]]+context\.Context' -- '*.go' ':(exclude)*_test.go' ':(exclude)vendor' ':(exclude)*/vendor/*' ':(exclude)testdata' ':(exclude)*/testdata/*'`)_
- **s-go-pinned-toolchain** go.mod pins the Go language version, and a workflow that sets a floating `stable`, `oldstable` or `latest` toolchain also pins one (go-version-file or a numeric go-version). _(checked by `krn standards check`: `f=go.mod; [ -f go.mod ] || f=go.work; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; grep -qE '^go[[:space:]]+[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$f" || exit 1; ci=$(cat .github/workflows/*.y*ml 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE "go-version:[[:space:]]*['\"]?(stable|oldstable|latest)" || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE "go-version-file:|go-version:[[:space:]]*(\[[[:space:]]*)?['\"]?[0-9]|go-version:[[:space:]]*[$][{][{]"`)_
<!-- krn-standards:end -->
